metadata.technology_specification: Discrete Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) card with dedicated VRAM
metadata.technology_reasoning: The most common and industry-standard form of GPU as of 2024 is the discrete graphics card used in PCs and workstations, incorporating a dedicated GPU chip with its own high-speed VRAM memory. This form dominates the market for gaming, professional graphics, and AI workloads, offering significant performance advantages over integrated graphics solutions.

components.reasoning: The core processing unit responsible for graphics computation and rendering, always present as the primary functional component.
High-speed memory (commonly GDDR6 or GDDR6X) used exclusively for graphics data, typically procured separately and attached to the GPU board.
The board that hosts the GPU chip, VRAM, power delivery components, and interfaces; always present and manufactured separately.
Includes VRMs and related circuitry to provide stable power to the GPU and memory, a critical and separately sourced component.

components.component: Cooling System (Heatsink, Fan, or Liquid Cooling Assembly)
components.reasoning: Essential for thermal management of high-power GPUs; commonly includes heatsinks and fans or closed-loop liquid coolers as a distinct assembly.
Physical ports (HDMI, DisplayPort) for connecting displays, usually integrated on the PCB but considered a distinct module for supply chain purposes.
The edge connector that interfaces with the motherboard PCI Express slot, standardized and separate component on the PCB.

GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).name: Silicon
GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).reasoning: Primary semiconductor material forming the GPU processor chip's silicon wafer, essential for device function and universally used in modern GPUs.

GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).name: Copper
GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).reasoning: Used for internal wiring and interconnects within the chip as well as in the packaging for electrical conduction; copper is standard in current semiconductor manufacturing.

GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).name: Aluminum
GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).reasoning: Commonly used for metal layers in semiconductor fabrication and bonding pads; aluminum layers aid in electrical conduction and heat dissipation.

GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).name: Gallium arsenide
GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).reasoning: Sometimes used in specialized GPU components or high-frequency parts; less common than silicon in mainstream GPUs but relevant in niche or high-speed components.

GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).name: Tantalum
GPU Processor Chip (Graphics Core).reasoning: Can be used for capacitors in the chip or packaging, though alternatives exist; moderately relevant for stable capacitance in GPUs.

Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.name: Silicon
Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.reasoning: Core semiconductor material forming the memory chips themselves, essential for VRAM function and universally used.

Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.name: Copper
Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.reasoning: Used in wiring layers and leads in memory chips and PCB traces for electrical conduction; standard material.

Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.name: Aluminum
Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.reasoning: Used in some bonding pads and metallization layers within memory chips.

Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.name: Tantalum
Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.reasoning: Material for capacitors often included in VRAM modules for stable power delivery; commonly used though alternatives exist.

Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.name: Polyimide
Dedicated Video RAM (VRAM) Modules.reasoning: Common polymer used as insulating layers and flexible substrates in VRAM packaging; widely accepted but polymer alternatives exist.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.name: Copper
Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.reasoning: Primary conductor material for traces and planes on the PCB; universally used for electrical connectivity.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.name: Fiberglass
Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.reasoning: Used as the main reinforcing substrate material (FR4) in most PCBs to provide mechanical strength and electrical insulation.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.name: Epoxy resins
Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.reasoning: Binder matrix material that holds fiberglass layers together and insulates electrically; industry standard in PCB laminates.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.name: Tin
Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.reasoning: Used as a coating or plating material for solder pads and component leads; common though alternatives like lead-free alloys exist.

Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.name: Silver
Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assembly.reasoning: Sometimes used in high-performance PCB contacts and surface finishes, though less widespread than copper or tin plating.

Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.name: Copper
Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.reasoning: Critical for winding in coils and conducting currents in VRM components; copper is standard for electrical conduction.

Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.name: Iron
Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.reasoning: Used in magnetic cores of inductors and transformers for the voltage regulation; essential for magnetic flux management.

Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.name: Aluminum
Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.reasoning: Used in heat sinks within VRMs and sometimes in capacitors; widely used but alternatives exist.

Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.name: Tantalum
Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.reasoning: Used in tantalum capacitors common in voltage regulation modules for stable and compact capacitance.

Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.name: Ceramic
Power Delivery Subsystem (Voltage Regula.reasoning: Used in ceramic capacitors within VRMs for high-frequency filtering and stability; commonly used though alternatives exist.

Cooling System (Heatsink, Fan, or Liquid.name: Aluminum
Cooling System (Heatsink, Fan, or Liquid.reasoning: Primary material for heatsinks due to its high thermal conductivity, low weight, and cost-effectiveness; industry standard.

Cooling System (Heatsink, Fan, or Liquid.name: Copper
Cooling System (Heatsink, Fan, or Liquid.reasoning: Used in high-performance heatsinks and heat pipes where better thermal conductivity is required; common but costlier than aluminum.

Cooling System (Heatsink, Fan, or Liquid.name: Steel Ingots
Cooling System (Heatsink, Fan, or Liquid.reasoning: Used in fan frames and mechanical parts for strength and durability; prevalent but alternatives like plastics exist.

Video Output Interface Connectors.name: Copper
Video Output Interface Connectors.reasoning: Primary conductive material in connector pins and contacts for electrical signal transmission; universally used.

Video Output Interface Connectors.name: Gold
Video Output Interface Connectors.reasoning: Used as plating on connector contacts to prevent oxidation and ensure reliable low-resistance connections; highly common.

Video Output Interface Connectors.name: Nickel
Video Output Interface Connectors.reasoning: Commonly used as an underlayer plating beneath gold for corrosion resistance and mechanical robustness.

Interface Connector (PCIe Connector).name: Copper
Interface Connector (PCIe Connector).reasoning: Essential conductive material for pins and contacts transmitting high-speed data signals; industry standard.

Interface Connector (PCIe Connector).name: Gold
Interface Connector (PCIe Connector).reasoning: Common plating material on contacts to prevent corrosion and ensure signal integrity; very prevalent though expensive.

Interface Connector (PCIe Connector).name: Nickel
Interface Connector (PCIe Connector).reasoning: Used as intermediate plating layer below gold for corrosion protection and mechanical durability.
